recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Future corrections to current date-prefix semantics should be handled under the later search-prefix Jira family rather than by adding redundant DSTU2-era sample values to this already-applied issue.
issue_request: FHIR-12414 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core search in DSTU2. It requested more examples for date searches with prefixes, especially partial-date values such as gt2016-03, ge2016-03, eq2016-03, and sa2016-03 when the searched value is implicitly or explicitly a range.
initial_application: Jira comments record svn revision 10509. The git-svn mirror commit c0ce6034c4dd973420c0471374107cec100bc3ba, '#12414 - search date examples', expanded source/search.html with detailed date-prefix examples for eq, ne, lt, gt, ge, le, sa, eb, and ap. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-12414 was present on the combined branch before this audit.
additional_context: source/search.html is the current FHIR-core Search page source. Its Prefixes and date sections now include formal prefix definitions, boundary interpretations, resource interval tests, a range interaction matrix, partial-date range examples, and a date search example table. Later Applied R6 issues FHIR-40319 and FHIR-43208 refined the same search-prefix/range area and are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Search page already explains the implicit and explicit range behavior requested by FHIR-12414 and preserves the expanded date-prefix examples introduced by the historical application, with later approved refinements.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 issue that simplified Search prefix definitions and added boundary interpretations/examples in the same source section; already represented on the combined branch.
Applied R6 issue that clarified less-precise date range examples in the Prefixes section; already represented on the combined branch.
